interpretation: All-site timing replaces old route-only timing; historical aggregate waits/holds are not comparable.
Histogram percentiles are bucket upper bounds. RetainedReplay covers complete subscribe with nonempty retained storage, including admission and replay enqueue.
Aggregate waits include subscriber ACK/outbound/maintenance work outside producer ACK critical path. Do not divide them by producer latency and claim causal lock-wait share.
Fixed 20k/s offered load is not a capacity benchmark.
Default off uses no clock or histogram allocation; ABBA P99/RSS show no regression. Diagnostic enabled mode has measurement overhead.
decision: A: current measurements do not prove single broker mutex is the dominant causal bottleneck; retain the single mutex and do not design/implement sharding.
